text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, I hardly know what to say...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wanted to make you smile this time, but with results like this happening again and again...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I'll end up
causing trouble for Trainer-san—"
choice_data_list: There's no way it's a bother!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I'll end up
causing trouble for Trainer-san—"
choice_data_list: There's no way it's a bother!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If I give up here,
all of Trainer's hard work will be for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I will never, ever let that happen.
...I promise.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...Why are you always so kind to me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your kindness, Trainer...
I'm sure it comes from your inner strength.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You're usually so cute,
yet you guide me so dependably.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I must live up to your expectations. I swear...
I will seize victory for you.
